assets.label: workshop hoists and press
assets.service: heavy vehicle component removal and pressing

control_failures.control_label: inspection and periodic proof testing of lifting gear

hazard_media: stored potential of an elevated component
facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop
facts.title: near hit during cleaning and preparation on HO-9401

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control LIFTING_GEAR_INSPECTION: the inspection and periodic proof testing of lifting gear was never verified as effective, and the accident investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the inspection and periodic proof testing of lifting gear on HO-9401 and record the spot check before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in planning and executing a lift, specifically directing a lift and controlling the drop zone. HO-9401 (workshop hoists and press) is in service for heavy vehicle component removal and pressing. The task proceeded during cleaning and preparation while the inspection and periodic proof testing of lifting gear was never verified as effective. The gravity energy involved is held as suspended load, and the recorded presentation was fall, collapse, crush.
response.summary: On 12 March 2008 a near hit was recorded on HO-9401 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop during cleaning and preparation; gravity energy held as suspended load was not released.
